question: Are your puppies vaccinated and health-checked?
answer: Yes, absolutely! Every PuppyNest puppy undergoes multiple comprehensive veterinary examinations, receives age-appropriate international standard vaccinations, microchip implantation, and comprehensive parasite treatment. You receive an official Veterinary Health Certificate, vaccination booklet, and Dubai municipality registration upon adoption.

question: Can I meet a puppy before I decide?
answer: Of course! We warmly invite you to our Downtown Dubai showroom for a private cuddle session. Spending unhurried time bonding face-to-face helps you feel the puppy's unique temperament, size, and personality before making any commitment.

question: Can I take my puppy home the same day?
answer: For puppies currently in our Dubai showroom, yes! If they have completed their scheduled veterinary clearance and starter transition period, you can take them home the same day. We provide a complete starter kit with essentials so your first night together is easy and cozy.

question: Do you import puppies from abroad?
answer: Yes. If you are looking for a rare bloodline or specific miniature size, we partner directly with premier, strictly licensed ethical breeders in South Korea and worldwide. Each breeder is hand-selected and adheres to the strictest global animal welfare standards.

question: How does an imported puppy travel to Dubai?
answer: Safety is our number one priority. Our imported puppies travel exclusively via VIP pet nannies in pressurized, temperature-controlled aircraft cabins—never in cargo holds. A dedicated caregiver monitors feeding, hydration, comfort, and cuddles throughout the flight until arrival at DXB.

question: Will I see photos and health details first?
answer: Always. We provide unfiltered 4K videos, close-up photos, parentage background, weight charts, and comprehensive veterinarian screening reports before you confirm any reservation. We believe in 100% transparency.

question: Do you deliver?
answer: Yes! We offer white-glove, climate-controlled door-to-door delivery throughout Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and across the UAE. We also coordinate safe international delivery to loving families worldwide with trusted global cargo partners.

question: Which breeds do you usually have?
answer: We specialize in miniature and teacup companions with hypoallergenic, low-shed coats: Maltipoos, Teacup Toy Poodles, Pomeranians, Cavapoos, French Bulldogs, and Shih Tzus. Each puppy has a sweet temperament ideal for apartment and family living.

question: Is there help after my puppy comes home?
answer: Always! Adoption is just the beginning of our relationship. Our dedicated puppy concierges and veterinary advisory network are available 24/7 on WhatsApp to guide you through potty training, nutrition, grooming, vaccine schedules, and settling in.

question: How do I reserve or pay for a puppy?
answer: You can reserve your chosen puppy directly through WhatsApp with our team. We accept major credit cards, bank wire transfers, and in-person payments at our showroom. A holding deposit secures your puppy while we finalize travel or showroom handover.
